reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: Article 3 sets a fixed 30% revenue share above an $11,000 monthly threshold with no obligation on the Company (Customer) to extend to HDI (Vendor) any better terms granted to third parties or to match third-party offers.
The rationale correctly distinguishes the Section 6.1 exclusivity/scope restraint from an MFN mechanic, so it is properly treated as outside this rule.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is unchanged from the original paragraphs and no deterministic checks failed.
Direction analysis is right: there is no Vendor-granted MFN to preserve and no Customer-side MFN obligation to delete, so the preferred position is already met.
